blocks.text: With Javier Bardem, Victoria Luengo, Raúl Arévalo
Languages Spanish, English With some English subtitles

Esteban is an Oscar-winning director. His daughter Emilia a struggling actor. He returns to Spain to make a film about the country’s exploitation of Western Sahara and offers her the lead role. The film shoot that follows isn’t a straightforward experience, demonstrating the unresolved tensions that still haunt their relationship. Guilt, resentment and forgiveness all intersect to powerful effect in this tense drama.

blocks.text: Set against a backdrop of widening class divisions and capitalist excess, Florian Zeller’s elegantly crafted psychological thriller is anchored by magnificent performances from Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem.
A genre-defying queer epic, rooted in the legacy of beloved writer Federico García Lorca, this is majestic and original filmmaking.
Michael Clayton director Tony Gilroy returns with a stylishly crafted portrait of a beguiling classical musician, played by Pedro Pascal.
